selection: first ten pinned real modules sorted by public module name
training_text: one canonical address-and-operation question per module
unfamiliar_queries: For {module}, name the responsible team, its alternate, and its implementation status.
I need the accountable team, backup team, and lifecycle of {module}.
Please tell me the lifecycle and identify the deputy and owner for {module}.
unknown_queries: For {module}, provide the private telephone number of its owner.
State the owner, deputy, and lifecycle of an.unwritten.module.
correction: change one duplicated owner value to an existing different owner value; this is an explicitly controlled source edit, not a historical repository claim
required_checks: held wording reaches actual learned field outputs
unknown address and unsupported fields are refused
independent process reopen preserves answers and optimizer
unrelated source edit preserves cell parameters
relevant correction fences old reads and stale candidate publication
continued optimizer trains corrected fields while preserving other modules
SIGKILL before publication commit rolls back
SIGKILL after publication commit before acknowledgment preserves the new release
revocation of any fitted dependency fences every affected read
limits: address and operation support come from an explicit public parser, not learned open-language OOD detection
model is a small freshly trained ReLU MLP, not a pretrained language model
all source bodies and training optimizer bytes are retained and counted
one trusted local SQLite owner, not distributed consensus or hostile administrator rollback protection
controlled field correction and process crashes, not observed production events
no compression or universal memory quality gain is inferred
